description: Which honua-helm markdown is part of the Open Knowledge Format bundle. Consumed by scripts/check-okf-bundle.py.

spec.name: Open Knowledge Format
spec.note: One markdown file is one concept; the file path is the concept's identity; relative markdown links are the graph edges. `type` is the only required frontmatter field.

workstream: WS9 — the other nine repositories. honua-helm is fifth.

conceptTypes.index: A section entry point. Enumerates what the directory holds so a reader or agent can choose before opening.
conceptTypes.concept: What a thing is and how it fits. No procedure.
conceptTypes.guide: A task someone performs, start to finish.
conceptTypes.reference: Lookup material: surfaces, options, contracts, matrices.

excludedFiles.why: GitBook's table of contents, generated from this bundle by scripts/generate-summary.py. Navigation over the bundle, not a concept in it.
The repeatable weekly operating rhythm for this repository's maintainers. Team process, not something an operator deploying the chart reads.
Dated execution evidence from one smoke run (2026-05-06), kept for the record. Evidence rather than procedure; the reusable procedure is smoke/aks-chart-smoke.md, which is in the bundle.

rejectedFields.timestamp: Not an OKF field in any version. The trust family spells the build stamp `generated`.

boundaryNote: A chart's documentation is almost entirely operator-facing: what it deploys, what values are stable, and how to verify an install. Only the maintainers' weekly cadence and one dated smoke receipt are out.
